1. Overview & Subscription Plans
1.1 Purpose and Scope
This Enterprise Billing, Payment and Refund Policy establishes the official commercial terms governing enterprise
subscriptions, software licensing, cloud compute resources, and auxiliary professional services provided by CloudScale
Inc. (“CloudScale”). This document uses simple, unambiguous English wording to enable direct, factual retrieval and
reference by enterprise customers and automated audit tools.
1.2 Subscription Cycles and Billing Options
CloudScale offers two recurring subscription billing options for enterprise accounts:
• Monthly Billing Cycle: Subscriptions are invoiced every 30 calendar days in advance. This option provides
   operational agility with no long-term contractual commitment.
• Annual Billing Cycle: Subscriptions are prepaid in advance for a continuous 12-month period. Clients selecting
   the annual billing cycle receive an immediate 15% upfront discount relative to standard monthly rates across all
   compute tiers and base platform licenses.
1.3 Automatic Subscription Renewal
All enterprise subscriptions renew automatically at the expiration of the active billing period to guarantee uninterrupted
service:
• Monthly Plans: Renew automatically every 30 days unless cancelled at least 48 hours prior to the next billing
   date.
• Annual Plans: Renew automatically for successive 12-month terms unless a written cancellation notice is received
   at least 30 calendar days prior to the annual contract expiration anniversary date.
1.4 Plan Upgrades, Downgrades, and Prorated Billing
• Plan Upgrades: Customers may upgrade subscription tiers or add compute nodes at any time. Upgrades take
  effect immediately. CloudScale assesses a prorated charge for the remaining days of the current billing cycle, charged
  immediately to the payment method on file.
• Plan Downgrades: Reductions in computing capacity or tier downgrades take effect only at the start of the next
  billing cycle. Mid-term credits, cash refunds, or prorated reimbursements are not issued for capacity reductions
  made during an active cycle.
1.5 Resource Metering and Overage Charges
Enterprise plans include baseline quotas for computing hours, NVMe storage, and network egress bandwidth. Resource
usage beyond baseline quotas is metered on an hourly basis and billed as overage charges at the close of each calendar
month at contracted standard rates.
2. Invoicing, Payment Methods & Net Terms
2.1 Accepted Payment Methods
CloudScale accepts multiple verified payment methods to streamline corporate procurement:
• Credit Cards: Visa, MasterCard, and American Express (Amex). Credit card payments are charged automatically
   on the invoice issuance date.
• ACH Direct Debit: Automated Clearing House electronic bank debits are supported for corporate accounts held
   at US financial institutions.
• SEPA Direct Debit: Single Euro Payments Area direct debits are available for corporate clients within the SEPA
   banking network.
• Wire Transfer: Direct Fedwire and SWIFT bank wire transfers are accepted for all Net-30 accounts and for any
   annual invoice exceeding $10,000 USD or 10,000 EUR.
2.2 Supported Operating Currencies
